$comment: Per-site login recipes (Cofre F-3). FIXED DATA — never model-authored, never user-authored, never fetched at runtime. Loaded by api/src/automation/login-recipes.ts and validated on load: every value must be a plain CSS selector, and the loader REFUSES the whole file rather than a single bad entry (a half-loaded registry is a registry nobody can reason about). Keys are eTLD+1-ish hosts matched the same way origin binding matches them, so a subdomain inherits its parent's recipe.

webmail.oa.pt.$note: Ordem dos Advogados webmail — Roundcube. The plan's terminal proof-gate portal: the only surveyed rail where a typist login is possible at all.

accounts.google.com.$note: Two-step: the password field does not exist until the identifier is submitted, which is what nextSelector exists for.
